Sam: Quick sync — saw intermittent staging frees hitting double-free in a churny tenant test. Short log inlined.

Sam: repro: restart tenant agent rapidly while firing ~150 tiny requests; occasionally host-staging free_async reports freed addr still referenced.

Lina: hmm. two ideas: (A) pin leases from kvcache handles so reconcile only frees unpinned leases, or (B) keep a bounded retire-queue with backpressure.

Omar: pinning seems nice since kvcache already tracks handles. API sketch: kvcache.pin(lease_id) / kvcache.unpin(lease_id). cheap for hot paths if pin is a noop when handle absent.

Sam: my concern: private deploys with slow NVMe frees could blow up memory if retireq grows; need per-tenant watermark and forced-block fallback.

Lina: agree. ops guardrails: retireq_limit, tenant_memory_watermark, and an alert when retireq_depth > threshold. If exceed, reconcile falls back to blocking reclaim for that tenant.

Omar: also add metrics: pinned_lease_gauge, retireq_depth, forced_block_count. makes debugging easier.

Sam: rollout plan: (1) quick mitigation: 40ms quiesce window on reconcile (config flag) to stop customer-facing failures, (2) implement kvcache.pin in medium term, (3) add watermark + ops alerts long term.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/lease-quiesce -> eng-runtime at 2026-03-13T02:00:00Z

Sam: I'll open a tiny hotfix PR for the quiesce flag and a followup RFC for pin API. Tagging @Lina and @Omar for review.
